items.question: What is the renewable energy capacity target that Masdar, the Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company, is pursuing by 2030?
items.fact: Masdar targets 100 gigawatts renewable capacity by 2030.

items.question: In what year was Masdar, the Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company, established?
items.gold: Masdar was established in 2006 through Mubadala Investment Company.
items.fact: Masdar was established in 2006 via Mubadala.
